issue.title: [DocDB] Backup/restore fails on colocated database due to schema packing issue

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-5376](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5376)
### Description

Create one rf=1 cluster without specifying any packed_row flag.
```
./bin/yb-ctl destroy && ./bin/yb-ctl create && ./bin/yb-ctl start && ./bin/ysqlsh
```

Repro
```
create database qqq with colocation = true;
\c qqq
create table tbl (k int, v int);
create index on tbl(k);
drop table tbl;
create table tbl (k int, v int);
create table tbl3 (k int, v int, v2 text);
create unique index idx2 on tbl3(v2);
create index idx on tbl3(v);
alter table tbl3 add primary key (k);

backup && restore:
./managed/devops/bin/yb_backup.py --masters 127.0.0.1 --remote_yb_admin_binary ./build/latest/bin/yb-admin --remote_ysql_dump_binary ./build/latest/postgres/bin/ysql_dump --remote_ysql_shell_binary ./build/latest/postgres/bin/ysqlsh --no_ssh --storage_type nfs --nfs_storage_path ~/yugabyte-data --backup_location ~/bug_repro/ --no_auto_name --keyspace ysql.qqq --verbose create

recreate a fresh cluster

./managed/devops/bin/yb_backup.py --masters 127.0.0.1 --remote_yb_admin_binary ./build/latest/bin/yb-admin --remote_ysql_dump_binary ./build/latest/postgres/bin/ysql_dump --remote_ysql_shell_binary ./build/latest/postgres/bin/ysqlsh --no_ssh --storage_type nfs --nfs_storage_path ~/yugabyte-data --backup_location ~/bug_repro/ --no_auto_name --keyspace ysql.qqq --verbose restore
```


The restore process cannot finish.
```
2023-02-03 10:24:27,995 INFO: Waiting for snapshot restoring to complete...
```

And tserver has fatal error: 
```
F0203 10:23:56.669042 12390 tablet_metadata.cc:241] TBL 00004000000030008000000000004006 T 498513c0ad4b4efdb9ddbbcf5e389644 P ca6f5d18a3484ff3be9f41356b5065fc: After merging schema packings during restore, latest schema does not have the same packing as the corresponding latest packing for table 00004000000030008000000000004006
```.

[DB-5376]: https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5376?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

issue.title: [DocDB] Restore task while migrating from the old colocation implementation to the new one gets stuck in IMPORT_SNAPSHOT and fails; Core file generated

repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-5751](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5751)

### Description

- Create a universe in 2.14 with automatic tablet splitting enabled
- Create a colocated database with tables opted in and out of colocation using the old schema; Create views and materialized views on these tables, Create Indexes(unique, partial and secondary) on the tables
- Execute DDLs', DMLs' on the schema
- Create a backup- B01
- Execute more DDLs, DMLs'
- Create a backup- B02 
- Upgrade the universe to 2.16 and add packed storage, auto scheduled compactions and Packed Columns + Packed and Colocation gflags
- Execute DDLs, DMLs' 
- Create a backup- B03 
- Execute DDLs, DMLs' 
- Create a backup- B04  
- Upgrade the universe to 2.18 
- Create a backup of the DB i
- Drop the databases created in step 2
- Restore the most latest backup
**Issue:**
Restore backup fails with 
```
Task id 3bfa06a2-1038-4791-878f-ac69e08c010f_PGSQL_TABLE_TYPE_cl_old_implementation_01 status: Failed with error COMMAND_FAILED.
```

**Logs:** https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/138jJrrADG87U2VebFAQE2Db5_esVsnpi?usp=share_link 
 
**Core file** is uploaded to the jumphost in this location- `/home/centos/kripa_cores/core_sq_worker.30790`
**Build:** 2.17.3.0-b44 
**Universe:** https://portal.dev.yugabyte.com/universes/ebd3565c-5a8f-4c2d-8531-a40d3abd61ed/overview
